title: 4. Numeracy & Number Systems: Ordering Whole Numbers
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.learningObjective: Determine which of two whole numbers is greater.
questions.question: Which number is greater, \(7\) or \(5\)?
questions.explanation: Compare the two whole numbers by their positions on the number line. The number \(7\) is farther to the right than \(5\), so \(7\) is greater than \(5\). Therefore, the greater number is \(7\).
questions.hint: On a number line, the number farther to the right is greater.

questions.learningObjective: Determine which of two whole numbers is smaller.
questions.question: Which number is smaller, \(12\) or \(15\)?
questions.explanation: Compare \(12\) and \(15\) by their positions on the number line. The number \(12\) is farther to the left than \(15\), so \(12\) is smaller than \(15\). Therefore, the smaller number is \(12\).
questions.hint: On a number line, the number farther to the left is smaller.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the correct order of three whole numbers from least to greatest.
questions.question: Which list shows \(8\), \(3\), and \(6\) in order from least to greatest?
questions.explanation: To order from least to greatest, start with the smallest number and end with the largest. Among \(8\), \(3\), and \(6\), the smallest is \(3\), the next is \(6\), and the largest is \(8\). Therefore, the correct order is \(3\), \(6\), \(8\).
questions.hint: Compare the numbers first, then arrange them from smallest to largest.

questions.concept: Comparing Numbers with the Same Digits in Different Places
questions.learningObjective: Compare two whole numbers by using place value.
questions.question: Which number is greater, \(19\) or \(91\)?
questions.explanation: Compare the tens digits of the two numbers. The number \(91\) has \(9\) tens, while \(19\) has only \(1\) ten. Since \(9\) tens is greater than \(1\) ten, \(91\) is greater than \(19\). Therefore, the greater number is \(91\).
questions.hint: Compare the tens digits first when the two numbers have the same number of digits.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the greatest number in a set of whole numbers.
questions.question: Which number is greatest among \(25\), \(52\), \(35\), and \(53\)?
questions.explanation: Compare the tens digits first. The numbers \(52\) and \(53\) have \(5\) tens, while \(25\) has \(2\) tens and \(35\) has \(3\) tens. Between \(52\) and \(53\), the ones digit \(3\) is greater than \(2\), so \(53\) is greater than \(52\). Therefore, the greatest number is \(53\).
questions.hint: Compare the tens digits first, then compare the ones digits if the tens digits are equal.

questions.concept: Ordering Whole Numbers in Descending Order
questions.learningObjective: Identify the correct order of four whole numbers from greatest to least.
questions.question: Which list shows \(31\), \(13\), \(33\), and \(23\) in order from greatest to least?
questions.explanation: To order from greatest to least, start with the largest number and end with the smallest. Among \(31\), \(13\), \(33\), and \(23\), the largest is \(33\), the next is \(31\), then \(23\), and the smallest is \(13\). Therefore, the correct order is \(33\), \(31\), \(23\), \(13\).
questions.hint: Arrange the numbers from largest to smallest, comparing the tens digits first.

questions.concept: Identifying a Whole Number Between Two Given Numbers
questions.learningObjective: Determine which whole number lies between two given whole numbers.
questions.question: Which whole number lies between \(47\) and \(49\)?
questions.explanation: The whole numbers in order are \(47\), \(48\), \(49\). The number that lies between \(47\) and \(49\) is \(48\). The number \(46\) is less than \(47\), so it does not lie between \(47\) and \(49\). Therefore, the correct number is \(48\).
questions.hint: List the whole numbers in order around the two given numbers.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the least number in a set of whole numbers.
questions.question: Which is the least number among \(60\), \(16\), \(61\), and \(6\)?
questions.explanation: Compare the numbers by size. The one-digit number \(6\) is smaller than the two-digit numbers \(16\), \(60\), and \(61\). Among the two-digit numbers, \(16\) is smaller than \(60\) and \(61\), but \(6\) is still the smallest. Therefore, the least number is \(6\).
questions.hint: Compare how many digits each number has first, then compare place by place.

questions.concept: Completing an Equal-Step Increasing Whole-Number Sequence
questions.learningObjective: Determine the missing number in an increasing whole-number sequence with a constant step.
questions.question: The numbers in a sequence increase by the same amount each time: \(6\), \(9\), \(12\), \(\Box\), \(18\), \(21\). Which number completes the pattern?
questions.explanation:
The sequence increases by \(3\) at each step:
\[
\begin{aligned}
6+3 &= 9\\
9+3 &= 12\\
12+3 &= 15\\
15+3 &= 18\\
18+3 &= 21
\end{aligned}
\]
The missing number after \(12\) is \(15\). Therefore, the sequence is completed by \(15\).
questions.hint: Find the equal difference between consecutive numbers in the sequence.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the correct order of four whole numbers from least to greatest.
questions.question: Which list shows \(42\), \(24\), \(44\), and \(40\) in order from least to greatest?
questions.explanation: To order from least to greatest, compare the numbers carefully. The smallest is \(24\). Among \(40\), \(42\), and \(44\), the order is \(40\), \(42\), \(44\). Combining these gives \(24\), \(40\), \(42\), \(44\). Therefore, the correct list is \(24\), \(40\), \(42\), \(44\).
questions.hint: Compare the tens digits first, then compare the ones digits when the tens digits are equal.
